richiami.difetto: Affected retractors may intermittently fail to auto-lock when a wheelchair is installed at a seating position equipped with an affected retractor. If this should occur a wheelchair may be inadequately restrained and the wheelchair occupant could be injured in the event of a crash.
richiami.rimedio: Affected retractors will be replaced with a free replacement retractor.
richiami.titolo: WHEELCHAIR SECUREMENT Retractor may not lock as designed
